title: Store local UI screenshots in gitignored /screenshots/ folder
summary: Save local UI screenshot captures, visual comparisons, and generated HTML galleries in /screenshots/ at the repository root (ignored by .gitignore) so the owner can open them directly from the repo without committing binary PNGs.
rationale: Owner requested (2026-11-24) that UI screenshots and galleries live in a gitignored folder inside the repository (/screenshots/) rather than only in an external session artifact directory. Keeping /screenshots/ in .gitignore preserves quick local access via Finder or screenshots/index.html while keeping Git clean.
head: 79bc5beecc11f39e9aac7dd43f494f8a9de365e9
review_rationale: Owner explicitly requested saving UI screenshots into gitignored /screenshots/ at repo root and remembering this convention.
